2607.13393.title: The Café in Amsterdam: When the Incumbent Becomes the Oracle
2607.13393.paper_summary: A field can reformulate its computations freely exactly where its demand is stated independently of any incumbent implementation, and finds itself unable to when the incumbent's own output has quietly become the specification. This note offers that observation as a lens on computational reformulation for modern accelerators, where posing a problem in a hardware-friendly form can yield large speed and energy gains, but only if a replacement can be judged at all. Building on the test-oracle problem (Weyuker; Barr et al.), on requirements engineering's notion of implementation bias (Zave and Jackson), and on the roofline performance model, it names the pathology "baseline capture" -- the moment an incumbent stops being evidence that a demand can be met and becomes the definition of meeting it -- and separates two questions that are easily confused: whether a reformulation can be judged (which turns on the existence of an incumbent-independent demand) and whether its discovery can be automated (which turns additionally on the cost of evaluating that demand). Short cases -- shortest-path routing, learnable audio frontends, ZIP-215 for Ed25519 signature validation, CESM-ECT for climate models, and a single-GEMM audio frontend -- illustrate the pattern and the move of "buying a verifier": making a demand explicit, operational, and independent of the incumbent. No component is claimed novel in isolation; the contribution is the synthesis and the single question it makes easy to ask of any reformulation result -- does its acceptance test mention the incumbent's output?
2607.13393.paper_summary_zh: 一個領域可以自由地重新構造其計算，正是在其需求獨立於任何現有實現的地方，當現有的輸出安靜地成為規範時，它卻無法做到。這篇文章將這一觀察作為對現代加速器計算重新構造的透鏡，在硬體友好的形式中提出問題可以帶來巨大的速度和能量增益，但前提是能夠對替代方案進行評判。基於測試預言機問題（Weyuker；Barr等人）、需求工程中實現偏見的概念（Zave和Jackson）以及屋頂線性能模型，它將這種病理命名為「基準捕獲」——當一個現有方案不再是滿足需求的證據，而成為滿足需求的定義的那一刻——並區分了兩個容易混淆的問題：重新構造是否可以被評判（這取決於是否存在獨立於現有方案的需求）以及其發現是否可以自動化（這還取決於評估該需求的成本）。短案例——最短路徑路由、可學習的音頻前端、ZIP-215 用於 Ed25519 簽名驗證、CESM-ECT 用於氣候模型，以及單一的 GEMM 音頻前端——說明了這一模式以及「購買驗證者」的轉變：使需求明確、可操作且獨立於現有方案。沒有任何組件被聲稱是孤立的新穎；貢獻在於綜合以及它使任何重新構造結果易於提出的單一問題——其接受測試是否提及現有方案的輸出？
2607.13393.author: Augusto Camargo et.al.
